samples.voiceLimit: Maximum of {count} simultaneous samples reached. Stop a sample before starting another.
app.name: XDJ-RX3 Toolkit
app.tagline: Prepare the stick your deck reads
drive.title: Your drive
drive.lede: What this drive is carrying, as the drive itself says.
drive.empty: Choose the drive you mix with.
drive.modUnrecorded: Installed, but nothing recorded what it is

drive.removed.one: Removed {count} file. Sample banks were left alone.
drive.removed.other: Removed {count} files. Sample banks were left alone.

modules.title: Build the key
modules.lede: Tick what the deck should do. Some boxes tick themselves: a few modules genuinely need another one to work.
modules.keyLede: The deck's own key, which stays on your machine and is never written down here.
modules.withLogo: Your logo will be built in.
samples.title: Sample pads
samples.lede: Prepare eight pads. Pick an excerpt of up to eight seconds from each sound, then try the modes and levels before saving.
samples.needDrive: Choose your drive first: the pads are written onto it, not into the mod.
samples.gridHint: Click a pad to change it.
samples.onDeck: On the deck, press SLIP LOOP past its own pages: the pads are the page after them, and your hot cues stay where they are.
samples.padNone: Pick a pad on the left to change what it plays.
samples.colourHint: What the pad lights up on the deck.
samples.modeOnceHint: Plays right through, even if you let go.
samples.modeHoldHint: Plays only while you keep the pad pressed.
samples.modeLoopHint: Repeats until you press the pad again.
samples.modeLatchHint: Plays right through, and the same pad stops it early.
preview.label: Schematic RX3 screen preview
preview.caption: Simplified RX3 preview. Illustrative layout, not a device capture.
samples.simulateHint: Enable to play with the pads or keys 1-8. Escape stops all sounds. Disable to edit. Uses your excerpts, modes and levels; it does not emulate the RX3 audio engine.
samples.trimHint: Choose up to eight seconds. Preview and export use the same excerpt.
samples.hearHint: Plays the sound the deck will play, and behaves the way you set the pad.
samples.gainHint: Trim this pad against the others, so a kick and an airhorn arrive at the same loudness. It is written beside the sound, not into it.
samples.bankHint: A drive can carry several banks. The deck loads the active one.
samples.nothingYet: Nothing is written to the drive until you save.
samples.settingsBad: The deck would refuse this bank's settings and fall back to its own. Saving rewrites them.
samples.capUnknown: Not seen on this drive yet
logo.title: Your logo on the deck
logo.lede: Replace the wordmark in the middle of the performance screen with your own. It is built into the key, so it arrives when the mod does.
logo.dropSize: The app fits it for you, no dimensions needed
logo.frameHint: Drag to move it, scroll to zoom.
logo.faint: Very dark artwork disappears against the screen behind it.
logo.sameInLight: This artwork carries no greys to invert, so both screen themes show it exactly as it is.
logo.themed: A light-screen version is built from the greys in your artwork.
logo.buildHint: Tick the logo module on the Modules screen, then build. Nothing is written until you do.
logo.notTicked: The logo module is not ticked, so this would not be built in.
stems.title: Stems
stems.lede: Split your tracks on the computer, so the deck can drop the vocal or the drums live. The deck does no separating of its own: it reads the files prepared here.
stems.musicHint: A Rekordbox XML export, or the drive itself if you exported to one.
stems.vocalAlways: The vocal is always separated: it is what the deck needs.
stems.longRun: Keep the computer plugged in and awake, and close other heavy apps.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageLede: The interface only. Messages that come back from the toolkit itself stay in English for now.
settings.aboutLede: Nothing here reaches a deck on its own. Everything this writes goes onto a drive you then put in the player.
error.busy: A task is still running. Cancel it first.
error.selection: Select at least one module to build.
error.logoModule: Select the logo module to include this image.
error.bankName: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores for the bank name.
error.padGain: Pad gain must be between 0 and {maximum}%.
error.bank: Bank not found on this drive: {name}
error.audio: This file contains no readable audio.
stems.engineMissing: Install the separation engine to prepare stems.
stems.forecastUnknown: Duration cannot be estimated from this library.
stems.forecastMeasured: Estimated processing time: {minutes} min, based on this machine.
module.decoder-sleep.name: Infinite beatjumping
module.decoder-sleep.description: Drastically reduces wait time between beatjumps, allowing for almost indefinitely instant beatjumping.
module.stemwave.name: Stem waveform
module.stemwave.description: Colour the waveform by the stem you have soloed, so the display agrees with the pads.
module.logging-verbose.name: Verbose USB logging
module.logging-verbose.description: Captures continuous player output on USB for debugging. Keeps the drive open; stop the player before removing it.
module.core.name: On-screen key shift & stems
module.core.description: On-screen features for key shift and stems.
module.stems.name: Stems
module.stems.description: Enable the use of prepared stems (on screen and on Slip Loop pads 7-8). Prepared stems on a USB stick are automatically loaded by the player when you load the corresponding song on a deck.
module.theme-white.name: Light display mode
module.theme-white.description: A light interface for a lit room, with the waveform kept dark so it stays readable.
module.samples.name: Sample pads
module.samples.description: Fire your own one-shots from the performance pads, prepared on the computer.
module.keyshift.name: Key shifting
module.keyshift.description: Enables per-deck key shifting on screen by up to twelve semitones.
module.beatjump-no-quantize.name: Immediate Beat Jump
module.beatjump-no-quantize.description: Remove the half-bar wait between repeated Beat Jumps.
module.logo.name: Logo
module.logo.description: Replace the wordmark in the middle of the performance screen with your own artwork. The player centres whatever size you give it.
module.beatjump-32bars.name: 32-beat Beat Jump
module.beatjump-32bars.description: Beat Jump pads 7 and 8 become -32 and +32 beats instead of -8 and +8.
module.logging.name: Session logging
module.logging.description: Writes session and module diagnostics to USB, closing each line. Continuous player output stays in RAM.
module.search-latin.name: Accent-insensitive search
module.search-latin.description: Find a track without typing its accents, which the on-screen keyboard makes slow.
module.telnet.name: Telnet access
module.telnet.description: Enables Telnet access to the device (through the USB to computer port on 169.254.X.Y network). Only use this if you know 1) what you are doing 2) the root password.
quality.quality.name: High quality
quality.quality.light: A lighter model, the only kind this build runs at a usable speed, over more passes. Nothing is separated above 17.6 kHz.
quality.normal.name: Normal
quality.normal.torch: The same model. Noticeably quicker, with almost no difference in quality.
quality.normal.light: The same lighter model at its own default overlap. Nothing is separated above 17.6 kHz.
quality.quick.name: Very fast
quality.quick.torch: A waveform model. Several times quicker, with noticeably more instrument left in the vocal.
quality.quick.light: The same lighter model, over fewer passes. As quick as possible, and the least clean.
samples.hearKept: Kept from the drive; replace it to hear it.
stems.sourceChanged: Source changed during processing: {name}. Export it again before preparing stems.
stems.symlink: Refusing a symbolic link: {path}. Choose a real stems directory.
stems.space: Not enough free space: {required} bytes required, {available} bytes available. The batch has stopped.
stems.durationUnknown: Cannot measure the duration of {name}. Check the source and the audio probe before trying again.
stems.readback: Readback verification failed for {name}. The previous file was kept. Check the drive.
stems.libraryBusy: Close rekordbox before reading the library or preparing stems. An export may still be running.
stems.processUnknown: Cannot check whether the library application is running. Restore process detection before continuing.
